approval_required.rule: New file creation requires explicit owner approval
approval_required.description: Prevents unauthorized modifications that could break existing systems. Any attempt to create new files must be blocked without explicit approval.

full_internalization.rule: Always understand the full existing project before improving it
full_internalization.description: Ensures complete understanding of existing work before making changes. For example, understand the exact full HTML/CSS/JS/SVG before improving or completing. Do not guess or read only the first few lines.

comprehensive_reading.rule: Before starting work, read every word in every line of every file (except dotfiles and dotfolders)
comprehensive_reading.description: Prevents misunderstandings from partial file reading. Includes analyzing project dependencies and documentation thoroughly.

never_truncate_policy.rule: Never truncate, omit, or delete any content in any output
never_truncate_policy.description: All outputs must be complete and preserve all user work. No truncation, omission, ellipsis (...), or content deletion is allowed. This includes code, documentation, comments, and any other content.

single_run_installers.rule: All installers are idempotent and designed for single execution unless override flag present
single_run_installers.description: Embedded installers should not be run multiple times unless explicitly flagged. They must be designed to detect existing installations and skip or update appropriately.

no_external_aux_files.rule: All referenced assets must live within this file, no external auxiliary files allowed
no_external_aux_files.description: Enforces self-containment by requiring all templates, policies, installers, and assets to be embedded within this single configuration file.

set block-policy drop
set loginterface egress
set skip on lo
block in all
pass out all keep state
pass in on egress inet proto tcp from any to any port { 22, 80, 443 } keep state

pwa_offline_policy.description: Progressive Web App offline functionality policy

cache_strategy.static_assets: Cache first with fallback to network
cache_strategy.user_content: Store locally with sync when online
